newsitem.title: USA: Concentric in settlement with Sattel.
newsitem.headline: Concentric in settlement with Sattel.

text.p: Concentric Network Corp reached a settlement with Sattel Corp regarding a pending lawsuit filed by Sattel.

Pursuant to the agreement reached July 10, Concentric will pay Sattel $4,400,000 for products that Concentric Network had purchased and received from Sattel. Concentric also agreed to purchase up to 25 percent of Concentric stock currently held by Sattel. Each company agreed to release each other from any further claims and Sattel released Concentric from any further obligation to purchase equipment from Sattel. Concentric Network has made adequate reserves for the Sattel litigation to account for the possible outcomes of the litigation.
